resources.string: When a text field requests the keyboard, keys follow the selected layout. Tap Shift for one capital, and double-tap it to lock. Keys stay raw when no text field requested input.
Alt+Shift and holding Space move through the selected layouts.
The space inserted at the start of the hold is removed when the layout changes.
Repeat the key, or replace it once with the symbol printed on that key. Alt or Sym types that symbol.

A short press of Sym shows the symbols keyboard. Double-tap Sym to lock symbols, the way double-tap Shift locks capitals. Keys then type the symbol printed on them, and the symbols keyboard stays up. Press Sym to unlock. Holding Sym with another key still types the symbol printed on that key.
